Coram:

The Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Aditya Kumar
 Mohapatra
 Order
05.12.2025 Order No.
01. Crlmc No.5033 of 2025 & I.A. No.3442 of 2025
1.
This matter is taken up through Hybrid mode.
2. Heard Mr. D.P. Nanda, learned senior counsel for the Petitioner as well as learned counsel for the State.
Perused the application as well as the prayer made therein.

3. By filing the present application under Section 528 of BNSS, the Petitioner seeks to quash the entire criminal proceeding arising out of FIR No.08 of 2020 law prefer EOW Bhubaneswar P.S. Case No.08 of 2020, which corresponds to T.R. Case No.414 of 2020, pending before the learned Sessions Judge, Khurda.

entities.text: EOW Bhubaneswar P.S. Case No.08 of 2020
entities.label: PETITIONER

sentences.text: The above noted case was registered for alleged commission of offence punishable under Sections 420, 423, 467, 468, 471, 120-B of IPC read with Sections 3(i)(g) & (q) of SC & ST (PoA) Act, 1989.

4. Learned senior counsel for the Petitioner at the outset contended that although the FIR was lodged in the year 2020, however, the investigation has not been concluded despite expiry of more than five years and no charge-sheet has been filed in the meantime.
He further contended that the Petitioner-company has been falsely implicated in the present case.

It was also contended that the M/S. Odisha Infratech Pvt. Ltd vs State Of Odisha And Another ..... ... on 5 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/26816353/
1 land, which was purchased by the company, was with the approval and sanction of the competent authority under the OLR Act.

entities.text: M/S. Odisha Infratech Pvt. Ltd vs State Of Odisha And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He further specifically stated before this Court that no complaint has been lodged at the instance of any person claiming himself to be a Victim of the alleged transaction.
5. In view of the aforesaid ground, this Court is of the view that the matter requires further consideration in presence of the opposite parties.
Accordingly, issue notice to the opposite parties.

6. Since the learned Additional Standing Counsel accepts notice on behalf of Opposite Party No. 1,
extra copy of the application be served on him within a week.
7. Issue notice to the Opposite Party No.2 by Registered Post/Speed Post with A.D. by fixing a short returnable date.
Requisites be filed within three working days.
8. List this matter in the week commencing 12.01.2026.

In the meantime learned counsel for the State shall obtain instruction in the matter as well as the case diary and the statement of the witnesses recorded under Section 161 of Cr.P.C.
 ( Aditya Kumar Mohapatra )
